summary: Regression smoke after react-native-google-mobile-ads upgrade 15.4.0 -> 15.8.3 (fix for the second EAS build failure: unresolved 'currentActivity' / 'runOnUiThread' at ReactNativeGoogleMobileAdsModule.kt in v15.4.0). Verified on the web preview: (a) node_modules/react-native-google-mobile-ads/package.json is on 15.8.3; (b) its ReactNativeGoogleMobileAdsModule.kt now uses 'reactApplicationContext.currentActivity' (new-arch-safe pattern) — the Kotlin errors from iter138 fix cannot recur; (c) frontend JS bundle still resolves the .native/.web platform-extension shim, no import crash. Anonymous login (nickname -> /terms via terms-checkbox + nda-checkbox testIDs -> terms-accept-btn) -> '/' home renders 6 feud-card-* items. Tapping feud-card-feud_599566d7133a opens /feud/feud_599566d7133a and 'ad-placeholder-feud-detail' testID renders the exact expected text 'SPAZIO PUBBLICITARIO / Visibile solo nel build nativo di produzione'. Console captured 0 error entries and 0 pageerror events; 0 'mobile-ads' / 'google-mobile-ads' / 'Cannot find module' strings across the full flow. Backend smoke: /api/ 200 (ok:true), /api/categories 200 (9 categories), /api/feuds/hype?limit=3 200 (feud list with feud_id/title/party_a/party_b). EAS Android build itself is out of scope for the web-preview agent — the user must re-trigger Publish to prove the Kotlin build now compiles.
action_items: User must re-trigger EAS Android build via Emergent Publish to confirm the ':react-native-google-mobile-ads:compileReleaseKotlin' task now succeeds with v15.8.3 (only real-toolchain verification can confirm this — web preview only proves the JS bundle side).

If the Android build still fails, next agent should inspect /app/frontend/node_modules/react-native-google-mobile-ads/android/build.gradle for the play-services-ads version (should stay on 24.6.0) and check Kotlin metadata version matches the EAS toolchain (currently Kotlin 2.1.0).
critical_code_review_comments: Verified /app/frontend/node_modules/react-native-google-mobile-ads is pinned at 15.8.3 in both package.json and installed node_modules — no drift.
Verified ReactNativeGoogleMobileAdsModule.kt lines 112, 114, 139, 144, 167, 168 all use reactApplicationContext.currentActivity (new-arch-safe pattern) — exact fix for the v15.4.0 failure mode.

AdBanner.tsx web stub logic is unchanged since iter138: Platform.OS === 'web' || isExpoGo -> renders 'SPAZIO PUBBLICITARIO / Visibile solo nel build nativo di produzione' with testID ad-placeholder-{placement}. Public API surface (BannerAd, BannerAdSize) is stable between 15.4.x and 15.8.x so no source-code change is needed in /app/frontend/src/ads/.
app.json config plugin block for react-native-google-mobile-ads (androidAppId/iosAppId) is unchanged as claimed.

Pre-existing (not related to this fix): expo-doctor still flags expo 54.0.35 / expo-constants 18.0.13 / expo-file-system 19.0.23 as slightly behind (.37/.14/.24). Worth a 'yarn expo install --fix' in a future chore PR but not blocking.
